decision: Use sentence case for command help headings
reason:
Sentence case matches the surrounding CLI prose and avoids inconsistent capitalization in generated help. The adjustment affects presentation in one command family and does not change parsing, cache behavior, or artifact identity.

The choice is cheap to reverse and has no shared runtime contract. It should remain unrelated to the watched cache-key discussion.
tradeoff: Existing screenshots and contributors may briefly retain the older title-case convention.

facets.label: Unrelated
facets.text: No caching, hashing, generator, or artifact concerns.
